privacy.content:
{app_name} ("the app") is made by {developer}. This policy explains what the app does with your information.

The short version

Your logs, settings, photos and videos stay on your phone. The app has no account, no ads, no analytics and no servers of ours. The only data that leaves your phone is what Google Play Services for AR collects when you use the AR Buddy cam on a supported phone (see below).

What the app stores on your phone

  • Sessions you log: the form (such as edible, dab, joint or vape), the quantity, edible strength in mg if you set it, and the time.
  • Settings: your buddy's look, your daily reset time, tolerance and other preferences.
  • Photos and videos you take with Buddy cam: saved only if you tap save, to your phone's Pictures or Movies folder, or shared only if you tap share and pick an app. Videos include sound from the microphone unless you mute it.

This is used only to show your buddy's state and your history. It is not sent to us or anyone else, and it is excluded from Google cloud backup.

Permissions

  • Camera: only for Buddy cam, to show your buddy in the room and take photos. Camera frames are processed on your phone and are not uploaded by the app.
  • Microphone: only while you record a Buddy cam video, for its sound. You can mute it. Audio stays in the video on your phone.
  • Display over other apps: only if you turn on the floating buddy, so it can sit on top of other apps. You can turn it off in the app or in Android settings at any time.
  • Notifications: the floating buddy shows a notification while it's running, which you can use to hide it.

Google Play Services for AR (ARCore)

On supported phones, Buddy cam uses Google Play Services for AR (ARCore), which is provided by Google and governed by the Google Privacy Policy. Google says ARCore collects device and user identifiers, diagnostic and performance data, and API usage data to analyse and improve AR. We don't receive this data. You can read how Google Play Services for AR handles your data. Phones without ARCore, and the selfie camera, use a simpler camera mode that doesn't involve it.

What we collect

Nothing. We have no servers, accounts, analytics, advertising or tracking SDKs.

Purchases

If you buy the app on Google Play, Google processes the payment under its own privacy policy. Google shares limited order details with developers as part of its payment process; we use them only to handle refunds and support.

Deleting your data

Use "Delete all logged sessions" in Settings, or uninstall the app or clear its storage in Android settings, to permanently delete what it stored. Photos and videos you saved stay in your gallery until you delete them. See how to delete your data for step-by-step instructions.

Age

The app is only for adults of legal age to use cannabis where they live (at least 18, or 21 where required). It is not directed at children and we don't knowingly collect anything from children.

Not medical or legal advice

The app is for personal tracking and fun. Your buddy's level is a rough guess, not a measure of impairment. The app does not sell cannabis, promote its sale, or help you get it.

Changes

We'll update this page and its date if the policy changes.

deletion.content:
{app_name} has no accounts and no servers, so everything it stores is on your phone and only you can delete it.

Delete your logged sessions

In the app, open Settings and tap Delete all logged sessions. This permanently deletes your history.

Delete everything

To remove all of the app's data, including your settings and buddy, do either of these:

  • Open Android Settings → Apps → {app_name} → Storage and tap Clear storage, or
  • Uninstall the app.

Photos and videos you saved from Buddy cam are in your gallery and stay there until you delete them yourself.

Data held by Google

Google Play keeps your purchase record, and Google Play Services for AR may hold diagnostic data, under the Google Privacy Policy. We don't receive or store this. Google explains how to manage it at myaccount.google.com.

Questions
